purpose: A single-line text field. It appears exactly ONCE in the whole project: the email field of the deliberately inert /auth form.

props.type: text (NOT type=email - the source uses type="text")
props.behaviour: INERT. No value, no onChange, no state, no name attribute, nothing read or stored.

states.rest: Webflow .w-input defaults, re-declared in the framework partition of the stylesheet
states.focus: NONE - *:focus { outline: none } with no replacement ring.

notes: COMPLIANCE: this primitive carries the pinned auth-inert-form asset role. It must stay inert in any generated output. See assets/asset-roles.json.
